```pipeline
read data/LHD_FXX_0657_6868_PTS_O_LAMB93_IGN69.copc.laz --statistics
! filter --vega "datum.classification == 2"
! sql "SELECT CASE classification WHEN 2 THEN 'Ground' WHEN 3 THEN 'Low vegetation' WHEN 4 THEN 'Medium vegetation' WHEN 5 THEN 'High vegetation' WHEN 6 THEN 'Building' ELSE 'Other' END AS label, floor((z - 42) / 4) * 4 AS band, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS n FROM input WHERE z >= 42 AND z < 78 GROUP BY CASE classification WHEN 2 THEN 'Ground' WHEN 3 THEN 'Low vegetation' WHEN 4 THEN 'Medium vegetation' WHEN 5 THEN 'High vegetation' WHEN 6 THEN 'Building' ELSE 'Other' END, floor((z - 42) / 4) * 4"
! chart rect --x band:O --y label:N --color n:Q
```
